about.title: About
about.p1: Front-End Developer at Pardazeshgaran Sepehr in Tehran since 2023, and Founder of Ganotic — an online store for natural wellness products. I focus on building scalable, responsive and maintainable user interfaces with React, TypeScript and component-driven architecture.
about.p2: Comfortable across the entire product lifecycle — from Figma wireframes and UI/UX design to robust front-end implementation, design systems, and seamless state management. Passionate about clean code, performance, and continuous learning.
about.p3: Before full-time front-end engineering, I spent two years teaching robotics and programming to students from elementary to high school and judging national robotics competitions at the University of Tehran. I hold an M.Sc. in Software Engineering (2026) with a thesis on agent-based architecture for smart environments, and completed my B.Sc. in 3.5 years.
